svg.title: Tariful Hoque, player one
svg.desc: An arcade title screen painted in rickshaw-art colours. A Dhaka-like street at sunset under bands of indigo, violet, pink, red, orange and gold, with a big ringed sun, birds, a minaret, a বেপরোয়া signboard and painted building fronts. A police car chases a red car along the road. The title reads Tariful Hoque, at LCTarif, game developer, Dhaka, press start, and the top strip says the game is at beporowa.netlify.app.
